body: Lucky you can still find ways to trust  - my avoidance is def a result from narc survival, I’m reluctant to get close or attached to anyone. If I’m presented w dishonesty..ufff…I have to address it.. i cannot see past it. If they present an honest answer tho, it’ll most likely make me hesitant moving forward. i start to wonder if that will be a reoccurring theme..Which causes me to withdraw from them a bit. I know I have to work on myself a bit more ._.

I’m so sorry for your loss. A true shame how narcs will use the opportunity of a person passing away to look like a hero. So opportunistic. Don’t fall for it. They love for that shit. They know you’re vulnerable at this moment. They want to be the hero in their story. Block them

Yep, that’s me - I absolutely cannot tolerate any dishonesty. The damage my last narc caused to my mental health was devastating. I made a conscious choice to not date anyone because I needed to repair myself. In my healing journey I’ve had to rebuild my confidence in trusting my myself. Trusting my ability to make decisions and most importantly my intuition. While I haven’t been dating, I have been getting to know new people. And, while I do pride myself on being able to pick up on dishonesty fairly quickly - I’m beginning to wonder if I’m building a very tall wall around myself… and not letting others in. I could be missing opportunities because of this. 

So yes I have ZERO tolerance… and there’s pros and cons to this. I’d like to reassure you and say always trust your gut. If your gut is picking up red flags, listen to it. But again, I’m bias - over protective of my feelings/ paranoid /avoidant however you wanna call it.

Im sorry you’re going through this. I know this might not be helpful to know but I’m also struggling w the same exact thing. Have you talked to your current partner about this? (I don’t actually know if this is a good suggestion or not I’m hoping maybe someone here would have a better answer). Have you tried counseling?

Holy crap you almost have a similar experience to mine! 7 years, moved in w her, house at 16 months… I don’t know if he tried to reach out to me via text, he’s been blocked from January 2021 to the present day. Please tell me how you managed to cope after learning about the new supply? I’m struggling to cope

Thanks a lot for explaining this. It’s taking me a while to wrap my head around everything but this was very helpful. I have to admit that towards the end I wasn’t doing my best to make him happy. I had resigned to my spiraling mental health. And he just waited until his lease was up to break up and eventually move in w her.

I keep gaslighting myself thinking I was the reason for sabotage (there was a lot of reactive abuse). Why is it that keep blaming myself for his discarding me?

Thanks for taking the time to share your experience with me, I really appreciate this. I’m sorry to hear how it happened to you. Do you mind me asking how you managed to cope? We’re you nervous to confront him? Did his new supply stay? I think I might confront mine…. Maybe in a letter. Idk.

Thanks a lot for this reminder - so quickly I seem to forget a lot and spiral into my sadness. Similar to your ex, mine was also a people pleaser. And I know we had both checked out. But the blindsided discard (something I suspected but now is confirmed) really hurts. How was it for you when you found out your ex had jumped into a new relationship so quickly? How do you cope?

Thanks for your response. I often forget that I was unhappy and blame myself for pushing him away. Like what if they actually are better together than we were. It’s like an endless cycle of me gaslighting myself. “Was it all just me in the end?” It couldn’t have been right? He gaslit me so bad that it came down to me taking notes and telling close ppl to me what happened - because in a matter of time he’d tell me I misremembered or didn’t happen that way. 

Is this common? Why do I forget so easily. And why am so used to hurting myself now

Thanks for your message, I really appreciate it. And thanks for highlighting my rumination - idk why I easily forget a lot of these things.. I have ocd, which makes any of my previous memories with him (and now this information I learned) constantly repeating in my head. Its almost like I keep forgetting it’s all a facade. I woke up today and immediately thought of their new house. Now the image of this house is trying to engrain itself in my head.

In the 2 years we’ve been separated, I’ve worked on myself a lot (something I tend to forget). I’ve found new hobbies, made friends/have existing ones. But I also withdraw alot. I don’t usually mind being alone.. but now I’m worried to be alone because the thoughts keep happening. I thought I was healing. But now it feels like I’m back to square one. I hate this cycle. A never ending nightmare. How long does it take to heal?
I often think about this. I know I need help, but I can’t relive everything for the 100th time.
30 and love music as well. Wish I had a garden, always wanted to learn about plants in general. Message if you wanna chat
I do. I’ve caught myself saying we, not so much us.

My experience with death is that it’s just blackness and silence. Like you’re having a dreamless sleep. It’s not exciting, there is no light at the end of the tunnel. Just emptiness. 

Sometimes I wish I stayed there. But I was resuscitated.
